comment_regular: SpecificItemCollector constructor for raycasts. Initializes collector and, when a TESObjectREFR is supplied, reads its collision filter via 0x65ABE0 and rewrites collision layer matrix row for layer a2 (or 0x1C if a2 < 0x18). LOS uses this, but movement climb probes should avoid unintended global mask churn unless needed.
